e599efa5-74d7-4a09-b3f9-97dfffed309d.description: Error ratio over 5m is above 14.4x the 1% error budget (fast burn); at this rate a 30-day budget lasts about 2 days.

facts.statement: checkout revision 2 was created at 16:53:19Z with change-cause 'payment client moved to port 9999'. Revision 1 dates from 16:41:10Z. The alert opened at 16:55:33Z.
The only pod-template difference between checkout revisions 1 and 2 is PAYMENT_ADDR, changed from payment:8080 to payment:9999.
payment has one revision (16:41:09Z, image 3.1.0-payment) and has not changed since.
Checkout's errors are gRPC dial timeouts to 10.96.166.193:9999 on oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge ('i/o timeout'). PlaceOrder fails with 'failed to charge card'.
payment's logs show its gRPC server started on 0.0.0.0:8080 at 16:42:09Z. Its last log line is at 16:53:18Z, with no error logs and no traces in the last 60 minutes.

checkout's Charge client spans switch to STATUS_CODE_ERROR from about 16:54Z. checkout's server-side error rate first appears at 16:54:58Z. The Charge error ratio is 0.53, and no other callee has errors.

checkout's 5m error ratio rose from about 0.35 to 0.51 over the last hour (peak 0.5064 at 16:55:49Z; later 0.6312). All 18 flagd flags are off. The namespace has no OOM kills or restarts, and its only warnings are old readiness failures at about 16:41.
checkout logged no error-level lines in the last 15 minutes, so the failures show only in traces and metrics.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: kubectl -n otel-demo get svc payment -o yaml, and check that its ports list 8080 and not 9999; also confirm checkout's env PAYMENT_ADDR.
hypotheses.statement: Payment's Kubernetes Service may not expose port 9999, which would confirm the dial failure is a port mismatch and not a network problem.

hypotheses.how_to_verify: kubectl rollout undo deployment/checkout, then watch service:sli_error_ratio:rate1m for checkout and the Charge client error series.
hypotheses.statement: Reverting checkout to revision 1 (PAYMENT_ADDR=payment:8080) should restore the Charge success rate and drop the checkout error ratio toward 0 within a few minutes.

inferences.statement: checkout's new pod, started at 16:53:21Z with PAYMENT_ADDR=payment:9999, is the source of the failures. Payment's silence after 16:53:18Z is consistent with calls never reaching it.
Payment is not the root cause. Its code, image and revision are unchanged, and its server spans show no errors. The fault is the address checkout uses to reach it.

root_causes.cause: Revision 2 config release set PAYMENT_ADDR to payment:9999, but payment serves on 8080. Every PaymentService/Charge call times out on dial, so about 43% of PlaceOrder requests fail. Fix: revert PAYMENT_ADDR to payment:8080 or roll back to revision 1.

diagnosis.summary: checkout's availability burn began at about 16:54Z, about a minute after its config release at 16:53:19Z. That release changed PAYMENT_ADDR from payment:8080 to payment:9999, the only pod-template change. Checkout's Charge calls now fail with gRPC dial timeouts to port 9999. Payment, which listens on 8080, receives no calls after 16:53:18Z and logs no errors. Payment's silence and its zero-error server spans are consistent with checkout never reaching it. No flags are on and no other change or warning exists. The fix is to restore PAYMENT_ADDR to payment:8080 in checkout (or roll back to revision 1), not to touch payment.

actions.reason: Revision 2 (16:53:19Z, 'payment client moved to port 9999') is the only pod-template change and sets PAYMENT_ADDR to payment:9999, where payment does not listen. Checkout's Charge calls fail with dial timeouts, causing about 43% of PlaceOrder failures. Reverting to revision 1 restores payment:8080.

alternatives.why_not: A restart would recreate pods from the same revision 2 template, so they would still carry PAYMENT_ADDR=payment:9999 and keep failing.
More replicas would copy the broken configuration and do nothing about the wrong port.
Doing nothing leaves the P1 fast burn running, with the 30-day budget gone in about 2 days. The cause is clear and the fix is a documented rollback.

plan.summary: Roll checkout back to revision 1, which restores PAYMENT_ADDR=payment:8080 and undoes the 16:53:19Z config release that sent Charge calls to port 9999. Expect the Charge error ratio and checkout's 5m error ratio to fall toward 0 within a few minutes; payment is not touched.
